research_question: Given the rise of AI-based knowledge management systems, what strategies can Lee's Market's knowledge management team implement to help maintain low employee turnover rates through 2027?

public_industry_facts: The November 2023 NBER working paper Generative AI at Work reports that an AI conversational assistant increased customer-support productivity, measured as issues resolved per hour, by 14% on average.
The same NBER study reports a 34% productivity improvement for novice and lower-skilled workers, with minimal effects for experienced and highly skilled workers.
The NBER study also reports increased employee retention following access to the AI assistant in its customer-support setting.
internal_company_metrics: A record 79% of the in-store staff at Lee's Market partook in customer relations retraining programs in Q4 2024.
The knowledge management team was able to update 89% of the SOP documents in light of the new safety regulations in Q1 2025.
According to the training results, only 67% of the warehouse staff have completed the 2025 SOP training.
